title: The Mysterious Helper
next_chapter_hook: The gate of the seventh layer Forbidden Grounds slowly opened, thick darkness surging forth like a tide, and in the deepest depths of that endless darkness, a familiar aura awaited Chen Ji—the helper who had always been hidden in the mist was finally about to reveal their true form.

text.content:
Chen Nian's warning exploded like thunder in his mind, and on the ancestral tablet deep within the shrine that had never been lit, a name that made Chen Ji's blood run cold was赫然inscribed—it was a name he never expected to find here.

His fingers trembled uncontrollably, and an unusual warmth suddenly emanated from the storage bag. The heat was so abrupt, as if something had just been placed inside, or as if it had been waiting for this moment for a long time.

The Tianji Record's fragmented pages wildly turned within the Mental Sea, and Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul seemed to sense the anomaly, yet remained uncharacteristically silent. Chen Ji took a deep breath, suppressing the surging emotions, and probed his divine sense into the storage bag.

His fingertips touched a warm jade stone, its temperature distinctly different from other artifacts, carrying an inexplicable sense of familiarity. His pupils constricted sharply—it was a brand-new Jade Slip, its surface smooth as a mirror, yet without any spiritual energy fluctuations, as if specifically created to wait for this moment.

dialogue.content:
(Chen Ji's fingers trembled slightly as he carefully retrieved the Jade Slip and placed it on his palm. The slip was pure white and warm to the touch, but what shocked him most was the mark engraved on one end—a mark he could not be more familiar with.)

Chen Xuan.

(These two characters were like a blade, stabbing fiercely into his chest. Why would a Jade Slip bearing Chen Xuan's name suddenly appear in his storage bag? And when had it been placed there?)

(Countless possibilities flashed through his mind, but none could explain this bizarre phenomenon.)

text.content:
Mo Xiansheng's voice finally resonated in the Mental Sea, carrying a hint of gravity: "The material of this Jade Slip is extraordinary. The absence of any spiritual energy fluctuations indicates it was deliberately sealed. For someone to place it in your storage bag without you noticing, their cultivation must be at least three major realms above yours."

Chen Ji did not respond. His gaze fixed intently on the mark on the Jade Slip. The Tianji Record's light patterns flickered faintly at his fingertips, seemingly responding to something.

He took a deep breath and slowly probed his divine sense into the Jade Slip. In an instant, an aged and majestic voice exploded in his mind: "Chen Xuan betrayed the Heavenly Secrets Path, and I swear to end his bloodline inheritance!"

dialogue.content:
(Chen Ji's pupils constricted violently, a chill climbing from his tailbone to his fontanelle. Betrayed the Heavenly Secrets Path? End the bloodline inheritance? These eight characters struck like a heavy hammer against his heart.)

(He thought of Chen Nian—his sister who had been missing for years, taken by the Holy Sect as the "Heavenly Fate Lock Key." Those vague foresight visions, where her presence meant an eternally unclear future...)

(Could this person know about Chen Nian's existence? Does the so-called bloodline inheritance refer to the two siblings?)

(Chen Ji's fingers tightened around the Jade Slip, his knuckles white. Emotions churned violently within him—anger, confusion, vigilance intertwined—yet he forcibly suppressed them.)

Remembered. Regardless of who this person is, since they dared to harbor intentions toward Chen Nian, they must pay the price.

text.content:
Mo Xiansheng remained silent for a moment before speaking slowly: "Chen Xuan... was once the chief disciple of the Heavenly Secrets Path, and also the last orthodox inheritor of the Tianji Record. Three hundred years ago, he suddenly defected from the Heavenly Secrets Path, established his own sect, and has been missing ever since."

Chen Ji asked gravely: "Why did he betray?"

A hint of complexity filled Mo Xiansheng's voice: "This question, even this old man wishes to know the answer. The Tianji Record chose him, yet he abandoned the Tianji Record... there must be hidden reasons behind this."

Chen Ji lowered his head, gazing at the Jade Slip in his hand, his brow furrowed tightly. The helper's identity was becoming clearer—they must have a profound connection with Chen Xuan, possibly fellow disciples or once close friends who became enemies.

But one thing was certain: this person knew about the existence of the Tianji Record, and might even be well-versed in the secrets of the Heavenly Secrets Path.

The voice within the Jade Slip did not stop; after that statement came an unsettling silence, followed by another voice—this time Chen Xuan's, aged and weary: "I knew you would find this day. The bloodline inheritance... is not what you think. The Tianji Record chose me, not because of outstanding talent, but because..."

The voice cut off abruptly, as if forcibly severed.

Chen Ji gripped the Jade Slip tightly, his knuckles white. The Tianji Record's light patterns violently fluctuated within his Mental Sea, seemingly responding to the unfinished meaning in Chen Xuan's words.

Not because of outstanding talent? Then because what? Why had Mo Xiansheng never mentioned these things? His gaze unconsciously drifted toward the faintly visible remnant soul deep within his Mental Sea, an indescribable chill rising in his heart.

dialogue.content:
(Mo Xiansheng seemed to sense Chen Ji's gaze; his remnant soul fluctuated slightly, yet he did not take the initiative to speak. That silence seemed to harbor some unspeakable complexity.)

(Chen Ji took a deep breath and flipped the Jade Slip over, and indeed discovered a line of small characters on the back—written with some special ink, so that even with his divine sense, he could barely make out a few words.)

Seventh layer Forbidden Grounds, I am waiting for you.

(These eight characters were like a key, opening a certain closed door in Chen Ji's heart. The seventh layer Forbidden Grounds—those were the deepest depths of the entire forbidden grounds system, said to bury shocking secrets from ancient times, where even old monsters at the Nascent Soul Transformation stage dared not tread lightly.)

(Did the helper's invitation there mean a trap, or true assistance?)

text.content:
Chen Ji's gaze shifted between the Jade Slip and the Tianji Record in his Mental Sea, his mind racing rapidly.

This person could place the Jade Slip into his storage bag without his察觉, proving their comprehension of spatial laws had reached an unimaginable realm. This person could precisely locate the blood connection between him and Chen Xuan, proving their deep knowledge of the Tianji Record's secrets. This person dared to arrange a meeting at the seventh layer Forbidden Grounds, either feeling secure in their advantage or harboring ulterior motives.

But regardless, this person held the answers he needed—about Chen Xuan, about the Tianji Record, about the mysteries of his own origins.

Mo Xiansheng's voice rang out again, carrying a warning: "The seventh layer Forbidden Grounds is no trivial matter. The things buried there are enough to cause the destruction of the entire cultivation world. Young man, are you certain you wish to go?"

choice.prompt: The clues left by the helper point to the seventh layer Forbidden Grounds, where secrets about Chen Xuan and the Tianji Record lie hidden. The journey ahead is fraught with danger, but perhaps the answers await you there. How will you proceed?

choices.description: Rather than waiting passively, take the initiative to strike. Set out immediately for the seventh layer Forbidden Grounds and confront the helper face-to-face on their chosen stage.
choices.visible_cost: The Unknown Dangers of the Seventh Layer Forbidden Grounds
choices.visible_reward: Potentially Obtain Key Clues About the Complete Secrets of the Tianji Record
choices.risk_hint: There May Be Entities Deep Within the Forbidden Grounds That Even Mo Xiansheng Cannot Cope With

text.content: A decisive gleam flashed in Chen Ji's eyes. Placing the Jade Slip into his storage bag, he rose, tidied his robes, and walked out of the shrine with steady steps. The Tianji Record's light patterns微微跃动within his Mental Sea, seemingly responding to his decision. "Since he wishes to see me," Chen Ji murmured softly, "then I shall meet him. The seventh layer Forbidden Grounds... I wonder what secrets are truly buried there." Mo Xiansheng remained silent for a moment, and ultimately did not try to dissuade him further.

dialogue.content: (Chen Ji stood at the entrance of the Forbidden Grounds, gazing at the bottomless abyss of darkness, the corners of his mouth slightly raised. He silently念道in his heart: Helper, helper, you set this局, exactly what do you want? But whatever you want, I will not let you have your way. This chess game is far from its endgame.)

choices.description: Entering another's home turf proactively is a major taboo. First hold your position and see what other moves this person has. Simultaneously investigate intelligence on the seventh layer Forbidden Grounds, and only act after making thorough preparations.
choices.visible_cost: May Miss the Opportunity for Direct Dialogue with the Helper
choices.visible_reward: Gain More Preparation Time and Reduce the Risk of Action
choices.risk_hint: The Helper May Change Their Attitude Due to Your Hesitation

text.content: Chen Ji placed the Jade Slip into his storage bag, a meaningful glint flickering in his eyes. "He wants me to proactively step into his home turf?" he冷笑in his heart, "How could it be that easy." The Tianji Record's light patterns微微跃动at his fingertips, seemingly expressing approval of his decision. Mo Xiansheng's voice resounded in his Mental Sea, carrying a hint of commendation: "Good lad, understanding the principle of strategic planning before action. This is what a true wise man does."

dialogue.content:
(Chen Ji turned and left the shrine, his steps unhurried. He silently念道in his heart: Helper, you have waited so long, surely you won't mind waiting a bit longer. But I wonder, when you discover I am not a chess piece to be manipulated, what expression will you make?)

(His gaze turned toward the distant horizon, toward the direction of the seventh layer Forbidden Grounds. The aura of the Forbidden Grounds was faintly perceptible, deep and诡异, like a slumbering giant beast.)

(Either way, he would go there someday. But not now, at least not before his chess pieces were fully arranged.)

text.content:
Night wind brushed past the ancient pine outside the ancestral hall, rustling softly. Chen Ji stood beneath the moonlight, his hand tightly gripping the jade slip, his gaze deep as an abyss.

Chen Xuan betrayed the Heavenly Secrets orthodox path—these eight characters were like a thorn, deeply embedded in his heart. The Tianji Record had chosen him, yet it made him endure Heavenly Fate's backlash. And Chen Xuan, the so-called betrayer, what had he experienced?

He recalled those hazy foresight visions, remembered the despair in Chen Nian's eyes when she was taken away, remembered the pervasive gaze of the Heavenly Dao's Eye...

All clues converge toward a single location—the seventh layer's forbidden grounds, where every truth lies buried.

dialogue.content:
Just then, an ethereal gaze passed over him from behind, a sensation like being stared at by some primordial beast, making one's hair stand on end. Chen Ji abruptly turned around, yet saw nothing.

But he knew—up there in the Void, something was watching him.

The Heavenly Dao's Eye—that terrifying existence that treated every generation's prophet as a chess piece. It had never truly vanished, merely hidden in the depths of the Void, waiting for the right moment.

Chen Ji's fists slowly tightened. He murmured: "Watching me? Then watch." His voice was calm, yet icy flames burned in his eyes, "When I raze the seventh layer forbidden grounds to the ground, I'll let you know that even chess pieces have days when they overturn the board."

text.content:
The Tianji Record's luminous patterns quivered slightly within his Mental Sea, as if responding to his determination. In that momentary contact, Chen Ji sensed a strange power flowing from the fragment, creating some resonance with the Heavenly Fate power within him.

Mo Xiansheng's voice rang in his Mental Sea, carrying a hint of approval: "You're finally beginning to touch the essence of the Tianji Record. Remember, the Tianji Record is not merely a tool for foresight—it is..."

The words cut off abruptly, as if some force had forcibly severed his voice. Chen Ji's brow furrowed slightly, but he didn't press further, merely deeply memorizing this sentence in his heart.

The essence of the Tianji Record... what could it possibly be?

choice.prompt: Mo Xiansheng's words were severed by some force, and the essence of the Tianji Record seems to hide an even greater secret. The collaborator's invitation still echoes in your ears. How will you deal with all this?

choices.description: The essence of the Tianji Record is crucial and cannot be easily dismissed. Attempt to forcefully awaken Mo Xiansheng's memories using the power of the Tianji Record to obtain more information.
choices.visible_cost: May consume a large amount of Heavenly Fate
choices.visible_reward: May obtain key information about the essence of the Tianji Record
choices.risk_hint: Forcefully awakening memories may trigger unknown dangers

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, injecting a thread of Heavenly Fate power into the Tianji Record fragment. The pale golden light immediately blazed intensely, like a blade piercing directly toward Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul. Mo Xiansheng's form shuddered violently, and a痛苦的低吟 rang through the Mental Sea.

dialogue.content:
(Mo Xiansheng's voice became fragmented: "The essence of the Tianji Record is... is... a fragment of the Heavenly Dao... It is not... not a tool for foresight... but rather..."

His voice grew fainter and fainter, eventually turning into a long sigh, "Enough... the time is not yet right... Your current cultivation... is insufficient to bear this truth..."

Chen Ji clenched his fists tightly, a strong sense of不甘 surging in his heart. But he also understood—Mo Xiansheng spoke true—at his current realm, some truths, even if known, would only bring disaster.)

choices.description: Since the time is not yet right, there is no need to force it. Focus on the matter at hand—the collaborator's invitation, Chen Nian's whereabouts, the secrets of the seventh layer forbidden grounds. When the time is ripe, the truth will naturally surface.
choices.visible_cost: Unable to obtain more information for now
choices.visible_reward: Preserve Heavenly Fate, accumulate strength for subsequent actions

text.content: Chen Ji slowly loosened his tightly clenched fists and took a deep breath. "Enough." he murmured, "Some things cannot be rushed." The Tianji Record's luminous patterns gradually settled in his Mental Sea, and Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul returned to silence once more.

dialogue.content:
(His gaze turned toward the distance, toward the direction of the seventh layer forbidden grounds. The collaborator's invitation was like a hook, piercing deeply into his heart. "The seventh layer forbidden grounds, I await you"—these words echoed ceaselessly in his mind.)

(Chen Ji silently calculated the time in his heart. Heavenly Fate consumption, the dangers of the forbidden grounds, the collaborator's true intentions... every step must be precisely calculated. He sneered inwardly: Think a jade slip can make me乖乖就范? Not so easy. But regardless, he would definitely go to the seventh layer forbidden grounds. It's just that before that, he still needs more preparation.)

text.content:
Moonlight flowed like water, scattered across the blue stone slabs outside the ancestral hall. Chen Ji stood with hands clasped behind his back, gazing at the faintly visible outline of the forbidden grounds in the distance, his eyes flickering with complex light.

Chen Xuan betrayed the Heavenly Secrets orthodox path—these words stirred layered ripples in his heart. He recalled everything he experienced at the Tianqing Sect, remembered those open attacks and secret schemes, the betrayals and machinations. If even the rightful heir of the Tianji Record could betray, then what remains of this so-called "Heavenly Secrets orthodox path"?

But on the other hand, Chen Xuan's words in the jade slip also aroused his suspicion—"Bloodline inheritance is not what you think"—what did this sentence mean? Was it referring to the blood connection between him and Chen Nian, or something else entirely?

dialogue.content:
(Chen Ji took out the jade slip from his storage bag and examined the text on it again in the moonlight. "Chen Xuan betrayed the Heavenly Secrets orthodox path, I swear to end his bloodline inheritance"—this sentence appeared as a condemnation of Chen Xuan, but upon careful品味, one could detect a certain peculiarity.)

(If the collaborator truly regarded Chen Xuan as a traitor, why leave a jade slip specifically engraved with Chen Xuan's name? Why arrange to meet him at the seventh layer forbidden grounds? Wouldn't directly killing him be more straightforward?)

(Unless... the collaborator's purpose was not simple revenge. He arranged to meet Chen Ji at the seventh layer forbidden grounds, surely having deeper schemes.)

Chen Ji sneered inwardly: Think a jade slip can make me乖乖就范? Not so easy. But regardless, he would definitely go to the seventh layer forbidden grounds. It's just that before that, he still needs more preparation.

text.content:
The Tianji Record's luminous patterns slowly circulated in his Mental Sea, seemingly responding to his thoughts. Chen Ji closed his eyes, letting those fragmented pieces of information collide and combine in his mind.

The collaborator—able to match Chen Xuan in power, knowing the secrets of the Tianji Record, able to silently place items into his storage bag, arranging to meet at the seventh layer forbidden grounds...

All clues pointed to the same conclusion: this person was by no means an ordinary enemy; the grudge between him and Chen Xuan was far more complex than what appeared on the surface.

And the seventh layer forbidden grounds likely concealed the key to solving all these mysteries.

choice.prompt: The collaborator invites you to meet at the seventh layer forbidden grounds, but that place is fraught with dangers. Before formally entering the forbidden grounds, how do you plan to prepare?

choices.description: Su Qingyao is an Inner Disciple Senior Fellow with formidable strength and exceptional intelligence. Although her favorability has not yet reached the level of complete trust, at critical moments, she is an ally you can rely on.
choices.visible_cost: May expose some of your secrets
choices.visible_reward: Acquire a reliable discussion partner and obtain intelligence regarding the Forbidden Grounds
choices.risk_hint: Su Qingyao has been secretly investigating you, possibly taking the opportunity to extract more information

text.content: Chen Ji turned and walked toward the Tianqing Sect Inner Sect. His steps appeared leisurely, but in his heart, he had already made his calculations. Su Qingyao—that woman who had always been secretly observing him—was his most suitable choice at present. Her strength was formidable enough, her intelligence sufficient to understand his predicament, and moreover... her knowledge of the Seventh Layer Forbidden Grounds would inevitably be greater than his.

dialogue.content: "Chen Ji?" Su Qingyao's voice was like icy spring water. "What brings you visiting in the deep night?" (Chen Ji smiled faintly, extending the Jade Slip before her.) "Senior Sister Su, I would like you to examine this." (Su Qingyao took the Jade Slip, her spiritual sense probing into it. When she saw those words, her pupils contracted sharply.)

choices.text: Prepare alone and act according to the original plan
choices.description: This matter concerns the mystery of his origins; the fewer who know, the better. Prepare supplies for the Forbidden Grounds alone, while using the Tianji Record to deduce possible dangers, striving to minimize risks to the utmost.
choices.visible_reward: Keep the secret, while possibly foreseeing more key information through the Tianji Record
choices.risk_hint: Solo action carries greater risks, and important intelligence may be missed

text.content: Chen Ji收起玉简，转身走向自己的居所。他的身影在月光下拉得很长，孤独而坚定。天机录的光纹在识海中微微跃动，似乎在期待着什么。

dialogue.content: 回到居所后，他立刻开始准备禁地所需的物资。疗伤丹药、恢复灵力的灵石、临时提升战力的秘术……每一样都是他多年积累的底牌。一切准备就绪后，他盘膝坐在床上，将天机录残页置于掌心。淡金色的光芒缓缓亮起，他的神识顺着玉简上的气息，向第七层禁地的方向探去——模糊的画面在脑海中闪现。黑暗、深渊、某种古老而恐怖的气息……还有一道若隐若现的身影，在等待着他。

text.content: 陈机缓缓睁开双眼，额头上已渗出细密的汗珠。天机录的预见让他消耗了部分天命值，但所获得的信息却极为有限——第七层禁地的危险远超他的想象，那里的气息古老而诡异，仿佛沉睡着某种不可名状的存在。而那道等待着他的身影，始终笼罩在迷雾之中，看不清面容。但有一点可以确定：相助者确实在那里等他。而且从气息来看，那是一个与陈玄同时代的存在，修为深不可测。

陈机将天机录残页收好，目光投向窗外。东方已泛起鱼肚白，新的一天即将来临。相助者的邀约如同一根刺，深深地扎在他心头。"第七层禁地，吾在等你"——这句话在他脑海中不断回响，激起层层涟漪。陈玄背叛天机正道，吾誓要终结其血脉传承——这句话究竟是相助者的真实心声，还是另有隐情？陈玄在玉简中未说完的话，又隐藏着怎样的秘密？一切的答案，都指向那神秘的第七层禁地。陈机深吸一口气，眼底闪过一丝决然。不管前方有什么危险在等待，他都必须去。不仅仅是为了解开自己的身世之谜，更是为了找到陈念——他失踪多年的妹妹，被圣宗作为"天命锁钥"带走的亲人。天机录的光纹在他识海中微微跃动，似乎在回应着他的决心。命运的棋局已经摆开，而他，即将成为执棋之人。

晨曦的第一缕阳光穿透云层，洒落在天青宗的废墟之上。陈机站在禁地入口处，望着那深不见底的黑暗深渊，神色平静。第七层禁地——那里埋葬着上古时代的惊天秘密，连化神期的老怪物都不敢轻易踏入。而现在，他要进去了。不是为了逞强，不是为了冒险，而是为了掌握自己的命运。他从储物袋中取出那枚刻着陈玄名号的玉简，最后看了一眼上面的话语。"第七层禁地，吾在等你"——这句话如同一道无形的牵引，指引着他迈出脚步。陈机深吸一口气，踏入了那无尽的黑暗之中。相助者，不管你是谁，我来了。
